headword: {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}

definitions.explanation: The direction directly contrary to the one in question. Everyday vocabulary for giving directions, describing traffic and train travel, and talking about movement in general.

examples.japanese: {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}の{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}ってしまった。
examples.english: I got on a train going the opposite direction.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}が{反対方向|はんたいほうこう}に{変|か}わった。
examples.english: The wind shifted to the opposite direction.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}を{間違|まちが}えて、{駅|えき}とは{反対方向|はんたいほうこう}に{十分|じゅっぷん}も{歩|ある}いてしまった。
examples.english: I took the wrong road and walked a full ten minutes in the opposite direction from the station.

notes:
{反対|はんたい} (opposite, reverse) + {方向|ほうこう} (direction). The thing being reversed is marked with とは: {駅|えき}とは{反対方向|はんたいほうこう} (the opposite direction from the station).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}に{進|すす}む: to go in the opposite direction
- {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}に{曲|ま}がる: to turn the other way
- {反対方向|はんたいほうこう}の{電車|でんしゃ}: a train going the other way

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}: reverse direction — nearly interchangeable, slightly more technical
- {逆|ぎゃく}: the reverse, the opposite — a noun on its own, used far more broadly than for physical direction
